title: Add New Skill drawer — selecting an existing skill from search results and assigning employees succeeds end-to-end
steps: Navigate to Employee → Skills
Open the Add New Skill drawer
Select a Department
Search for an existing skill name and select it from the results
Assign at least one employee
Save
expected: Drawer closes; the skill+department+employee assignment appears in the Skills Listing without reload
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): using add skill we can create skills and select skills, add anything that is showing in that field, assign employee

title: Add New Skill drawer — typing a name with no existing match offers 'Create new Skill' and any resulting option in the field is selectable
steps: Open the Add New Skill drawer
Type a skill name guaranteed not to already exist
Confirm 'No match found' and '+ Create new Skill' are shown
Select 'Create new Skill' and complete any required fields (e.g. Logo URL)
Assign employees and save
expected: New skill is created and appears in the Skills Listing with the assigned employees
automationHint: New-skill Save silently no-ops unless Logo URL is filled — confirmed live per skills.page.ts comment; fill it to avoid a false negative.
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): add skill we can create skills and select skills, add anything that is showing in that field

title: Selecting a Department in Skills scopes the listing to that department's skills/employees only
steps: Navigate to Employee → Skills
Select a specific Department
Observe the Skills Listing
expected: Only skills/employees relevant to the selected department are shown
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): later select department from selecting the department we can view all the employees

title: Selecting one department and skill opens the Skill Detail Panel where assigned employees can be edited
steps: Select a Department, then a skill in the Skills Listing
Open the Skill Detail Panel's edit control
Add or remove an employee from the assignment
Save
expected: Skill Detail Panel reflects the modified employee list immediately, without reload; combined count updates to match
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): by selecting one department and skill we can edit the skill too and modify the employees

title: Tags on a skill can be used to search/filter the Skills Listing
steps: Identify a tag associated with an existing skill
Type that tag into the search field
Observe the Skills Listing
expected: Skills carrying the searched tag appear in the results, in addition to (or instead of) name-based matches
automationHint: NOTE: underlying rule is speculative — verify with a human before treating a failure as a confirmed regression. Tag-based search behavior not previously captured in KB.
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): also check the tags — they can be used to search the skill too

title: Employees in the Skill Detail Panel are sorted by Availability % in descending order
steps: Select a skill with multiple assigned employees
Read each employee's Availability % as displayed
Compare consecutive rows
expected: Availability % values are in strictly non-increasing (descending) order top to bottom
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): the employees visible will have availability percentage shown in decreasing order

title: Employees with tied Availability % maintain a stable secondary sort order
steps: Select a skill where two or more employees share an identical Availability %
Record their relative order
Reload and re-check the order
expected: Tied employees keep a stable, repeatable relative order
automationHint: NOTE: underlying rule is speculative — verify with a human before treating a failure as a confirmed regression.

title: Selecting multiple skills together shows the combined (union) list of employees holding any of them
steps: In the Skills Listing, select two or more skills simultaneously (multi-select)
Observe the resulting employee list
expected: The employee list shows the union of employees who hold ANY of the selected skills
automationHint: Multi-skill selection UI/control unconfirmed against live app — locate generically (checkbox/multi-select on skill rows).
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): we can see multiple skills together to see employees with those selected skills

title: Multi-skill selection — an employee holding more than one selected skill appears only once, with no duplicate row
steps: Select two skills known to share at least one common employee
Observe the combined employee list
Search for that employee's name in the result set
expected: The shared employee appears exactly once in the combined list, not once per matching skill
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): we can see multiple skills together to see employees with those selected skills

title: Filtering the Skill Detail Panel by 'Primary' narrows the list to Primary holders only
steps: Select a skill with both Primary and Secondary holders
Apply the Primary filter
expected: Only employees classified Primary for this skill remain visible; the panel's count matches the filtered row count
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): skills can also be filtered using primary and secondary

title: Filtering the Skill Detail Panel by 'Secondary' narrows the list to Secondary holders only
steps: Select a skill with both Primary and Secondary holders
Apply the Secondary filter
expected: Only employees classified Secondary for this skill remain visible
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): skills can also be filtered using primary and secondary

title: Clearing the Primary/Secondary filter restores the full combined holder list
steps: Apply the Primary or Secondary filter on the Skill Detail Panel
Clear the filter
expected: Full combined Primary + Secondary holder list is restored
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): skills can also be filtered using primary and secondary

title: Deleting a skill that still has employees assigned in the selected department is blocked
steps: Select a skill with one or more assigned employees in the current department
Attempt to delete/unlink the skill
expected: Delete/unlink is blocked; a message shows the Primary/Secondary breakdown of remaining holders
requirementRef: KB-direct: employee-details/skills.json edgeCases — delete blocked while holders remain

title: Removing every assigned employee one-by-one, then deleting the skill, succeeds once the count reaches zero
steps: Select a skill with a small number of assigned employees in the current department
Remove each assigned employee one at a time until the count is 0
Attempt to delete/unlink the skill
expected: Delete/unlink succeeds once — and only once — the department's assigned-employee count for this skill is 0
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): to delete any skills we need to make sure that all the employees are removed one by one

title: A skill with zero employees in the current department but assigned elsewhere still requires delete confirmation
steps: Select a skill with 0 employees in the current department but known to have holders in at least one other department
Attempt to delete/unlink
expected: A delete/unlink confirmation pop-up is still shown (classification/other-department usage does not silently bypass the confirmation)
requirementRef: KB-direct: employee-details/skills.json edgeCases — cross-department skill usage confirmation

title: Availability % shown in the Skill Detail Panel matches the value returned by the API for the same employee
steps: Read the Availability % for the top-sorted employee in a Skill Detail Panel
Fetch the corresponding employee/availability API endpoint
Compare values
expected: UI-displayed Availability % exactly matches the API value
automationHint: NOTE: underlying rule is speculative — verify with a human before treating a failure as a confirmed regression.

title: Double-clicking Save on the Add New Skill drawer does not create duplicate records
steps: Fill in the Add New Skill drawer completely
Click Save twice in rapid succession
expected: Exactly one skill/employee-assignment record is created, not two
automationHint: NOTE: underlying rule is speculative — verify with a human before treating a failure as a confirmed regression.

title: Multi-skill selection can be cleared, restoring the single-skill (or unselected) Skill Detail Panel view
steps: Select two or more skills to view the combined employee list
Deselect all but one (or all) skills
expected: Panel returns to showing the single selected skill's holders, or the default/no-selection state, with no leftover combined-list rows
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): we can see multiple skills together to see employees with those selected skills
